scope: Existing maintained metadata and configuration browser harness on the canonical HTTPS hostname.
checks: deployment serves a Content-Security-Policy header
registration creates an authenticated empty private workspace
created project uses a persistent UUID route
project description renders as text rather than HTML
catalog reference coverage is shown independently
no disconnected execution controls exist
project persists across refresh and deep links
project name and description save through backend
new projects have an empty experiment collection
new experiment uses the API profile default
creating an experiment persists immutable version 1
editing creates version 2 and exact parameter differences
version 1 retains its exact original specification and hash
saving unchanged fields does not create a version
historical revision is read only and retains its saved value
historical version deep links survive refresh
duplication uses the selected historical version and records provenance
experiment deletion has a cancellable confirmation
deleting a copied experiment removes its revisions
cancelling unsaved navigation keeps the experiment draft
a concurrent client saves version 3
optimistic conflict preserves all draft fields
adopting a newer base refreshes the displayed history while preserving the draft
explicit conflict recovery saves the retained draft as version 4
comparison identifies every changed supported field
experiment launch availability matches the server capability
experiment history and comparison fit a 390 px viewport
expanded immutable specification fits a 390 px viewport
private drafts are not persisted in browser storage
project results never borrow the external qualification run
light theme persists on reload
data view has no horizontal overflow at 390 px
expanded provenance has no horizontal overflow at 390 px
project list has no horizontal overflow at 390 px
a second account cannot open the first account project
cross-account GET PATCH DELETE all return 404
cross-account experiment reads mutations history comparison and duplication return 404
real CSRF rejection is displayed with session reload recovery
CSRF rejection did not create a project
missing cookie / unauthorized response clears private project content
delete confirmation can be cancelled
delete removes the live project
logout invalidates the server session
sign-in view has no horizontal overflow at 390 px
legacy explorer loads its recorded data
legacy explorer navigation remains functional
no uncaught browser errors in workspace or explorer
workspace and explorer have no CSP console errors
all loaded web fonts are ready
limitations: The metadata harness creates and deletes a project and versioned configurations; it does not rerun estimation, investigation, comparison or export.
Persistence checks use browser refresh and sign-in, not a new database or service-restart rehearsal.
Removing session cookies tests unauthorized-session handling; it does not wait for actual eight-hour expiry.
Automated browser checks do not establish external expert usability or a complete accessibility audit.
The exact two QA accounts, their remaining sessions and private username budgets were subsequently removed; aggregate budgets were preserved.
